pieces.doc: Action button inside a toast (e.g. "Undo"). Apply on a `<button type="button">` so Space / Enter dispatch a native click.

inputs.name: altText
inputs.doc: Self-contained text read aloud in place of the visible label so the user knows how to recover the action after the toast is gone. Required for time-limited toasts per WCAG 2.2.1; defaults to `''` (no alt text).

pieces.doc: Close button inside a toast. Apply on a `<button type="button">` so Space / Enter dispatch a native click. Clicking emits `(close)` from the parent `[forToast]` with reason `'manual'`.
Supplementary description for the toast. Registers its generated id with the parent `[forToast]` so `aria-describedby` is wired automatically.

Element holding the toast's accessible name. Registers its generated id with the parent `[forToast]` so `aria-labelledby` is wired automatically. Apply on whatever heading element fits (`<strong>`, `<h2>`, `<div>`).

Mounted once near the root of the app — typically inside `app.html`. Listens to `ForToastManager.toasts()` and renders each programmatic toast inline. Position the viewport from CSS (`position: fixed`, `top|bottom`, `left|right`) — the directive doesn't impose any.

inputs.name: label
inputs.doc: Accessible name for the viewport region. Default `'Notifications'`.

inputs.name: hotkey
inputs.doc: Hotkey to focus the viewport. Default reads from `provideForToastDefaults`, falling back to `F6`.

inputs.name: maxVisible
inputs.doc: Maximum number of toasts rendered at once. Older toasts collapse out of the visible stack but stay in `manager.toasts()` until dismissed. `Infinity` (default) renders all live toasts.

inputs.name: swipeDirection
inputs.doc: Default swipe direction(s) applied to every programmatic toast that doesn't override `swipeDirection` in its own config. `null` (default) keeps swipe disabled unless explicitly opted into per-toast.

inputs.name: swipeThreshold
inputs.doc: Default dismiss-distance in pixels applied to every programmatic toast that doesn't override `swipeThreshold` in its own config.

pieces.doc: One toast notification. Apply on a `<div>` (or `<output>`, `<section>`) — the directive sets `role="status"` (`'info'` / `'success'` / `'warning'`) or `role="alert"` (`'error'`), `aria-live`, and the timer / pause machinery.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.doc: Auto-dismiss timer in ms. `0` keeps the toast sticky.

inputs.name: closable
inputs.doc: Whether Escape and the close button can dismiss the toast. Defaults to `true`. Set `false` for a sticky / forced-action toast — the consumer must dismiss programmatically (e.g. via the `(close)` output after the action button has been clicked).

inputs.name: swipeDirection
inputs.doc: Direction(s) the user can swipe to dismiss the toast. Pass a single direction (`'right'`) or an array of directions (`['right', 'down']`). `null` (default) disables swipe.

inputs.name: swipeThreshold
inputs.doc: Pixels of pointer travel along the active swipe direction needed to commit a dismissal. Defaults to `50` — matches Radix.

outputs.name: close
outputs.doc: Emitted when the toast wants to be unmounted. The consumer reacts by removing it from the rendered list.

outputs.name: swipeStart
outputs.doc: Fired once on the move that arms the swipe.

outputs.name: swipeMove
outputs.doc: Fired on every pointer move while the swipe is active.

outputs.name: swipeEnd
outputs.doc: Fired on pointer-up after the threshold is crossed (immediately followed by `(close)`).

outputs.name: swipeCancel
outputs.doc: Fired on pointer-up before the threshold, or on `pointercancel`.
